subject: Mutual Action Plan — target close & procurement cut-off alignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elliott Johns <elliott.johns@econovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + proposed milestone dates (next steps)

Hi Elliott — great to meet earlier. Per our discovery call, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that lays out milestones, suggested owners, and a proposed target close window. High level:

- Target close: week of Nov 15 (we proposed Nov 15–19)
- Primary procurement signature cutoff: Nov 8 (internal PO & legal signoff to allow onboarding 11/16)
- Delivery dependencies: SSO config, Data Retention addendum, and production IP allowlist

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones tab), SOW_outline.pdf, pricing-sheet.xlsx

Could you confirm: 1) whether the Nov 8 procurement cutoff is realistic on your side, and 2) who on your team will own SSO and procurement? If useful, we can push the target close back one week — want to align on what procurement requires.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement owner + any blackout dates by Tue 10/20
2) Redwood updates MAP with responsibility matrix and firm dates by Wed 10/21
3) Procurement signoff (Econovate) by Mon 11/8

Thanks — attaching the MAP now.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx] [attachment: SOW_outline.pdf] [attachment: pricing-sheet.xlsx]

From: Elliott Johns <elliott.johns@econovate.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@econovate.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@econovate.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed milestone dates (next steps)

Vivek — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick notes from procurement and ops after a fast internal sync:

- Procurement: Nov 8 is tight but achievable if legal has a final SOW and our procurement gets the PO by Nov 2. We have a budget freeze the week of Nov 1 which slows approvals.
- SSO & security: Sofia (cc'd) will own SSO configuration and scoping; she needs the retention addendum and an outline of network requirements by Oct 25 to schedule engineering time.
- Contract review: Our legal wants a 3 business day review window after Redwood provides the redline-ready SOW.

Given the budget freeze week, a safer signature runway for us would be Nov 15, but we can escalate to hit Nov 8 if Redwood can provide a final SOW + retention addendum by Oct 23 and coordinate an early PO.

Action items on our side:
- I will confirm a named procurement approver by Tue 10/20 (should be Maria Ortega from Procurement).
- Sofia will send a short list of SSO questions by Thu 10/22.

Elliott
Head of Product, Econovate
[external: procurement@econovate.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP + proposed milestone dates (next steps)

Vivek / Ben — forwarding Elliott's notes. Quick take:

- If Econovate needs the Nov 15 signature runway, we should propose a split plan: primary (Nov 8) if they can accelerate, fallback (Nov 15) if procurement budget freeze blocks PO. That preserves momentum and gives sales a clear escalation path.
- Legal: Ben, can you confirm if we can realistically deliver a redline-ready SOW + retention addendum by Oct 23? I want to be conservative and assume we need until Oct 26 unless you can commit resources.

Callouts:
- Dependencies to list explicitly in MAP: network/IP allowlist lead time (Ops), SSO test window (Security), customer PO date (Procurement).
- Suggested milestone owners in the attached MAP v1: Econovate — Procurement (Maria Ortega), SSO — Sofia Alvarez, Redwood — Ben Carter (SOW/legal), Vivek — commercial/PO follow-up.

Please add your availability for a 30m alignment call today (10/20) or tomorrow morning — I'd like to lock dates into the spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elliott Johns <elliott.johns@econovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@econovate.com>, procurement@econovate.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed milestone dates (next steps) — alignment & final ask

Elliott / team — thanks for the clear context. This note captures the MAP updates we agreed and the firm asks to align the procurement runway. Please treat the list below as the canonical mutual action plan for planning: 

Mutual Action Plan (canonical items):
1) Redwood: Final SOW (redline-ready) + Data Retention Addendum — deliver by Fri 2026-10-23 EOD. Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood Legal). [attachment: SOW_outline.pdf]
2) Econovate: Named procurement approver (Maria Ortega) and initial PO window — confirm by Tue 2026-10-20 COB. Owner: Elliott Johns.
3) Econovate: SSO scoping answers + IP allowlist info — deliver by Thu 2026-10-22. Owner: Sofia Alvarez.
4) Mutual: Pricing confirmation (final sheet) and internal approval notes — Redwood to finalize pricing adjustments by Wed 2026-10-21; Econovate to confirm any budget constraints by Mon 2026-11-01.
5) Contingency dates: If Redwood meets Oct 23 deliverables and Econovate provides PO by Nov 2, target signature week: Nov 8 (preferred). If Econovate cannot deliver PO by Nov 2 due to the budget freeze, fallback signature week: Nov 15.

Dependencies called out for procurement runway:
- Legal turnaround (3 business days after Redwood provides redline-ready SOW)
- Finance PO issuance relative to internal budget freeze (Econovate week of Nov 1)
- Security SSO window (requires answers by Oct 22 to hit Nov onboarding)

Final ask: please confirm by EOD Tue 2026-10-20 whether Econovate will commit to the accelerated PO path (PO by Nov 2) or prefers the Nov 15 fallback. If we get a confirmation to pursue the accelerated path, Redwood will prioritize SOW delivery and block legal resources to meet the Oct 23 timeline.

If helpful, I'll spin up a 30-minute alignment call for Wed 10/21 10:00 PT — propose calendar invite if that time works.

Thanks all — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx]
